en.summary: A Hong Kong cyclist found dead in September sustained fatal throat injuries from multiple dog bites, though forensic pathologists may be unable to identify the specific animals involved.

en.title: US consumer confidence sinks to 12-year low over inflation, stagnant wages

en.summary: The 33rd China Television Golden Eagle Awards ceremony took place in Changsha on September 29. Yu Hewei and Song Jia received the best actor and actress awards for their performances in television dramas.

en.title: 10th Pingyao International Film Festival Awards Announced
en.summary: The 10th Pingyao International Film Festival held its awards ceremony in Pingyao Ancient City on September 29. The film "Final Payment," directed by Shanxi-based director Niu Niu, won the Fei Mu Award for Best Film and Best Actor.

en.title: (Aichi·Nagoya Asian Games) Roundup: Chinese badminton team closes with two golds; track and field blooms at multiple points
en.summary: On September 29, the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games awarded 34 gold medals across multiple sports including badminton and track and field. China's badminton team finished the Games with 2 golds, 3 silvers, and 3 bronzes after winning a mixed doubles gold and silver medals in men's and women's doubles.

en.summary: At the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games diving competition, the Chinese team secured both the gold and silver medals in the women's 10m platform and men's 3m springboard events.

en.summary: Chinese memory chip manufacturer CXMT plans to invest 34.9 billion yuan in expansion, allocating funds across technology research and development and wafer testing facilities while prioritizing domestic suppliers of chipmaking equipment.

stories.title: Why Citi is betting on China’s 30-year bonds as US Treasury yields climb

en.title: Why Citi is betting on China's 30-year bonds as US Treasury yields climb
en.summary: Citibank analysts have become optimistic about Chinese 30-year government bonds, expecting their yields to decline to around 1.8 percent despite rising US Treasury yields. The bank recommends investors increase their positions in China's long-term sovereign debt based on easing supply pressures and improving market conditions.
